related_work.work_intent_goal: Mature mncs-compiler for reliable native multi-module application development while advancing verified self-consumption
related_work.campaign_objective: Mature mncs-compiler for reliable native multi-module application development while advancing verified self-consumption

pressure_hypothesis.title: Affected-work pressure summaries omit the campaign objective alongside the work-intent goal
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An authentic Compiler campaign observation records both campaign_objective and work_intent_goal. The bounded pressure summary returned for that record retained the work-intent goal but omitted campaign_objective; a later live projection after the refinement exposed both fields independently.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve campaign_objective separately from work_intent_goal in affected-work pressure contexts, merge missing objective context only when the stable work identity has one compatible value, and retain conflicting objectives as separate contexts.
not_measured: whether omitting the campaign objective caused an agent to misattribute this pressure
how often campaign objectives differ from work-intent goals across campaign history
whether exposing both objective levels changes agent development decisions
time, token, cache, or resource impact of the omission

outcome.analysis_limit: The pre-change response establishes a field-omission gap for this authentic Compiler evidence. The recorded campaign objective and work-intent goal happen to have the same text for this observation; distinct values are covered by regression tests and are not inferred from this historical record.

not_measured: whether the missing campaign objective was used or needed by another agent
recurrence across distinct Compiler sessions or projects
whether adding the objective reduces source-record navigation
